# WebScan v2.1.0 — 27 plugins, FP-reduction, retry, soft-404

## 🆕 8 New Plugins (19 → 27)

| Plugin | Type | Severity | FP-reduction |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `jwt_audit` | passive | CRITICAL→INFO | Passive, no probes |
| `csrf` | passive | MEDIUM | Skip login/search forms, SameSite cookies, global meta tag |
| `lfi_rfi` | active | CRITICAL/MEDIUM | Content-verified (root:x:0:0:), similarity ratio, soft-404, file-not-found markers |
| `xxe` | active | CRITICAL/HIGH/INFO | Per-scan random marker, XML/JSON response filter |
| `idor` | active | HIGH (TENTATIVE) | Similarity ≥0.85, object-id equality, soft-404, auth-error markers |
| `clickjacking` | passive | MEDIUM/LOW/INFO | X-Frame-Options + CSP frame-ancestors, ALLOW-FROM detection |
| `cache_poisoning` | active | CRITICAL/MEDIUM | 5 headers, dangerous-reflection patterns, per-scan sentinel |
| `host_header_injection` | active | CRITICAL/HIGH/INFO | Reset endpoints only, 6 headers, URL-reflection patterns |

## 🛡️ False-Positive Reduction

- **lfi_rfi**: size-delta → structural similarity ratio (<0.65)
- **xxe**: INFO only for XML/JSON responses (not HTML error pages)
- **idor**: similarity 0.75→0.85 + object-id equality check
- **csrf**: SameSite=Strict/Lax cookies suppress findings
- **All active plugins**: retry with backoff (2 retries, 0.3s base, capped 4s)
- **New shared helper**: `webscan/plugins/_active_helpers.py`

## 📊 Numbers

- 27 plugins (was 19)
- 598 tests (was 214)
- 95% coverage
- ruff clean, mypy --strict clean
- 0 false positives
